spec.name: Furniture Coffee Table
spec.description: Low birch coffee table with three thick tabletop boards, four square legs, recessed supporting aprons and a two-board lower shelf. Warm hand-painted wood, subtle joinery and narrow board gaps create grounded survival-server furniture. Bounds: x 0.25–31.75, y 0–13, z 0.25–15.75; front faces negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: low birch coffee table with lower shelf. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
